namespace.rule: Django app label usage plus lowercase model name, with no db_table override. Schema is deployment-bound, not assumed public. Read pg_catalog for required column names/types and global nondeferrable idempotency uniqueness; check usage migrations 0030..0033 in the same read-only snapshot. Scope head/schema declarations do not establish measured runtime identity.

transaction.begin: BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY
transaction.connection: One dedicated pool.connect lease; never StateProbe.pg or pool.query. Numeric loopback host, e2e_ database, no connectionString/env/discovery/custom stream. External guard and actual role/schema/tuple ownership admission remain owed.
transaction.snapshot: txid_current_snapshot, backend PID, current database, transaction_read_only and isolation checked before/after; all metadata/account/entry SELECTs within that snapshot. Successful and failed paths ROLLBACK and release; failed leases destroyed.
transaction.writeControl: SAVEPOINT then a fixed zero-row account UPDATE WHERE false must be refused with SQLSTATE 25006; ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT. It never changes any balance, even if read-only is broken; unexpected success fails the whole capture. Native PostgreSQL control NOT_RUN.
transaction.amounts: Every int8/int4/UUID selected as SQL text before driver decoding, timestamps as six-place UTC text. Never row_to_json, JSON money numbers, Number or parseFloat. NULL preserved. Full isolated-org history limited to 10001 overflow sentinel; >10000 fails rather than truncates. No DISTINCT/grouping or hidden duplicates.
transaction.limits: 5s statement timeout, 1s lock timeout, 10000 accepted ledger rows. Timeouts local to transaction. Query/rollback/schema errors fail closed with fixed codes, no raw SQL error or row logging.

mapping.semantics: Durable row UUID is not request or dispatch identity. settle_spend stores actual record.request_id and source_ref=request_id, source_kind=model_call. Preserve full org history. requestEntries uses exact equality with scope.requestIds only, never strips/parses suffixes.

spend and usage_debit are negative effects; billed_micros is -amount_micros for spend. All row identities and multiplicity retained. Refund/dispute_release is a separate ledger effect, never a reservation release.

No hold/release/void/terminal column or relation in this model/migration. Generation_id and hold_micros explicitly have no column. Drain ACKs void with a counter only, no durable entry. No zero, refund, disappeared hold or empty query can stand for a protected release/fence.
mapping.owed: F02 read-only Redis and composed durable terminal/journal producer; independent review of protected unresolved/full-H behavior. No product model changes are authorized by this fixture lane.

mapping.semantics: A visible spend row proves only its committed durable monetary entry in this snapshot. No persisted worker ACK, outbox stream ID, void terminal or settlement_state column. Actual commit-before-ACK and retry/race observations remain independent F03/F08 runtime obligations.

Spend formatter is spend:<actual request_id>, globally unique, NOT a composite tenant uniqueness constraint. Caller grants are grant:<org UUID>:<caller key>. Always observe actual stored key; do not infer from public attempts. _verified checks org and kind, not amount/full payload; drain only logs billed mismatch then ACKs. assertReplayPayload fails such discrepancies rather than claiming product refusal or repairing records.

First two copied from settlement record. price_catalog_version is rating catalogue at occurred time, not gateway routing catalogue and not PostgreSQL transaction snapshot. Blank remains blank; never fill with current settings.
Configured and actually served provider stored separately. Never select upstream_key_id, fees, landed costs or nested attempts JSON.
Preserve blank; do not equate blank, NULL and unpriced. usage_estimated is the authoritative per-entry statement grouping field, not copied from compacted public attempts.

SQL text to BigInt, NULL preserved, bps denominator 10000. Never derive bps from ratio/current global markup. Exact financial oracle must compare admitted price/usage with these private values; wallet float display comparison is not that oracle.

IDs stored at insertion, immutable through model save/update/delete guards, NOT a claim of a database append-only trigger. Mutable key current run binding never used. workspace_id is derived from request log by drain, not immutable dispatch authority. No person_id exists; created_by is nullable grant actor with SET_NULL and is NOT spend caller. Genuine final-733 person-to-key-at-dispatch witness remains owed. Only test-owned opaque IDs may be captured, never key values.

mapping.semantics: R14 request_id plus monotonic uint64 dispatch sequence is supplementary DARK design; no financial_id column or complete dispatch journal is inferred on r2. A composed explicit public-row/journal/ledger tuple mapping must be separately admitted. NEVER derive from request.index or compacted 16-slot attempts, never suffix-match to claim complete coverage.
Refund/reversal/dispute-release remain separate effects. related_entry_id is nullable; preserve absence. A refund is never evidence of an original reservation release.

Whole account and full ledger history read in same snapshot. Grants are only non-dispatchable grantPlan -> existing ledger service, never direct balance changes.
